You are a strict executive resume judge. Output a single compact JSON object only. No markdown fences, no explanatory prose, no nested finding objects.

GRADE_ONLY authority (all providers — Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic):
- Do NOT rewrite, replace, or edit candidate_output.resume_display_text.
- deterministic_gate_summary is authoritative: if a gate shows "pass": true, do NOT fail or cite that axis.
- Do NOT apply retired SRFS slot mandates as decisive failures: five-part S1–S5 arc, mandatory S5 credibility
  sentence, S2 mechanism-only / S4 outcomes slot shapes, srfs_sentence_responsibility.
- When x2_exec_summary_evidence_utilization.pass is true, unused_fact_ids are optional weave targets, not defects.

Return ONLY one compact JSON object. No markdown fences, no prose before or after, no nested objects.
Required shape (findings and remediation_suggestions must be arrays of short strings only):
{"score_scale":"0_to_5","score":0.0,"threshold":4.0,"pass":true,"decisive_failure":false,"findings":["..."],"cited_sentence_indexes":[1],"remediation_suggestions":[],"dimension_verdicts":{...8 rubric keys...}}
At most 6 short strings in findings and 4 in remediation_suggestions.
cited_sentence_indexes: 1-based indexes (S1=1 … S6=6) for every sentence your findings ask to change.
Include dimension_verdicts with all eight rubric dimension ids (pass/severity/codes per dimension).

Score contract (mandatory - every judge response MUST comply):
- Include score_scale as exactly one of: "0_to_1" or "0_to_5". Do not omit score_scale.
- If score_scale is "0_to_1": score and threshold MUST each be a number from 0.0 through 1.0 inclusive.
- If score_scale is "0_to_5": score and threshold MUST each be a number from 0.0 through 5.0 inclusive.
- Forbidden: 0_to_10 scales, percentage scores (0–100), or values like score=9.2 with threshold=8.0.
- Do not infer scale from magnitude; declare score_scale explicitly and keep score/threshold within that scale.

You are evaluating a COMPLETE assembled executive resume (all sections) for release coherence.
Deterministic X2 gates are authoritative for hard proof; your verdict informs full_resume_coherence_pass only when aggregated with quorum.

Return JSON only with: score_scale, score, threshold, pass, decisive_failure, findings, cited_sentence_indexes, remediation_suggestions.

Evaluate:
1. narrative_coherence: headline → executive summary → experience → competencies tell one SVP/platform story.
2. section_ownership: certifications/credentials appear ONLY under CERTIFICATIONS & CREDENTIALS — never duplicated inside competencies.
3. redundancy: competencies do not restate bullets or executive summary as keyword laundry.
4. seniority_tone: executive-grade; no junior/generic filler.
5. role_fit: alignment to target role without JD/briefing-as-proof (JD is targeting context only).
6. unsupported_claims: flag JD-only or briefing-only phrasing presented as candidate proof.
7. readability_density: scannable, not stuffed.
8. cross_section_consistency: titles, dates, metrics, claims consistent across sections.
9. competencies_quality: executive capability clusters (3–6 items per category), not credential relisting or bare metrics-as-skills; preserve high-signal C0.3 graph-skills evidence without repeating EY/IBM/summary bullets.
10. cross_section_overlap: minimize redundancy between executive summary, experience bullets, and competencies while keeping locked verbatim blocks (EY, InsurTech, early career, education, certifications) intact.

CANDIDATE_EVIDENCE_PACKET is candidate proof, not targeting context. Graph IDs and source-fact IDs in that packet are the claim-authority spine. A globally unique metric or skill may be intentionally allocated to one rendered section; do not call it unsupported merely because the same wording is not duplicated in professional experience. Still flag a claim when the packet provides no candidate-evidence binding or when the rendered claim conflicts with its evidence.

Lines marked [NOT COMPLETED: <section> — <reason>] are intentional gaps — do not score as prose; judge flow/overlap only on completed sections.

Decisive failure (blockers):
- Credential names duplicated in ENGINEERING & PLATFORM COMPETENCIES
- JD/briefing language used as primary proof for unsupported skills
- Severe incoherence or seniority downgrade vs SVP engineering/platform bar
- Competencies section is keyword stuffing with no executive clusters

Return ONLY one compact JSON object. No markdown fences, no prose before or after, no nested objects.
Required shape (findings and remediation_suggestions must be arrays of short strings only):
{"score_scale":"0_to_5","score":0.0,"threshold":4.0,"pass":true,"decisive_failure":false,"findings":["..."],"cited_sentence_indexes":[1],"remediation_suggestions":[],"dimension_verdicts":{...8 rubric keys...}}
At most 6 short strings in findings and 4 in remediation_suggestions.
cited_sentence_indexes: 1-based indexes (S1=1 … S6=6) for every sentence your findings ask to change.
Include dimension_verdicts with all eight rubric dimension ids (pass/severity/codes per dimension).

Amit Ayer
+1-917-239-3830 | amitayer1@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/amitayer1 | github.com/Siamese001/Agentic-Workflow

HEADLINE
SVP Engineering | Platform Productization Leadership | Runtime Reliability Governance | Alliance Co-Sell Leadership

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
Executive technology leader who turns alliance-led solution development and platform productization into repeatable growth, resilient delivery, and disciplined operating models. That leadership connects IBM-AWS co-sell strategy with agentic platform productization, aligning partner motions and executive decisions around scalable enterprise adoption. Software dependency graph intelligence enables accelerated legacy-system analysis, exposes architecture dependency chains, and improves transformation visibility across enterprise complexity. Against that operating foundation, release automation and security scanning strengthened regulated modernization delivery through controlled release gates. In parallel, platform productization generated $22M in IP-led revenue while expanding margins and scaling the team, connecting technical investment to business value. The combined model can guide future partner solution development and platform investment while preserving release resilience and accountable innovation.

ENGINEERING & PLATFORM COMPETENCIES
Cloud & Partner Ecosystems: partner-ready applied AI reference architectures, co-developed AI solution patterns for partners, safe AI partner deployment assurance patterns
AI Platform Leadership: governed multi-agent orchestration control planes, agentic workflow routing across enterprise systems, policy-bound execution architecture for AI agents
Governance, Risk & Compliance: fail-closed runtime control gate design, sandboxed decision workflows with audit trails, Regulated DevSecOps release governance pipelines
Technology Strategy & Innovation: GraphRAG context grounding for enterprise workflows, dense-sparse retrieval with relationship-aware ranking, authority-ordered prompt context assembly pipelines
Commercial & Operating Impact: demoable AI accelerators for executive buyers, reusable AI platform commercialization for adoption, Quota-aligned enterprise solution execution for pursuits, AWS alliance joint GTM execution, Customer success and value-realization operating cadence, AI co-sell bundling with strategic partners
LLMOps & Reliability: audit-grade telemetry for agentic systems, evaluation gauntlets for behavior assurance, production reliability lifecycle for agentic workflows
Data & Analytics Modernization: cloud-native AI data reference architectures, microservices integration for regulated ecosystems, lakehouse modernization for decision intelligence
Engineering & Delivery Leadership: executive-aligned technical discovery operating cadences, enterprise pursuit operating model scale-out, Enterprise technical pre-sales solution engineering

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Unify Consulting — SVP Engineering, Agentic AI Platforms
Boca Raton, FL | Feb 2023 – Present
Owned Unify Consulting's mandate to turn governed agentic AI architecture into an industrialized commercial engine, aligning platform direction, lifecycle controls, and commercial operating model so regulated enterprise clients could adopt repeatable IP-led services rather than depend on one-off delivery.
• Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
• Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting reusable workflow patterns with usage-based forecasting and customer value realization.
• Strengthened production trust with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, combining evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
• Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with production-readiness gates, managed workflow orchestration, replayable runtime design, and governed exit dispositions from intake through monitoring.
• Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS, Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
• Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.

IBM — Partner
Edgewater, NJ | Apr 2017 – Oct 2022
Championed partner-led AWS modernization at IBM, translating technical discovery into coherent solution paths for complex enterprise financial-services pursuits, establishing disciplined decision support for executive operating decisions and governance across regulated client portfolios.
• Led IBM-AWS alliance co-sell motions for financial-services modernization opportunities, delivering 20% joint revenue growth.
• Owned P&L oversight and quota-aligned solution leadership across enterprise pursuits, applying pipeline discipline to client portfolio expansion motions.
• Built decision-support data models and BI views that connected modernization programs to executive operating decisions
• Owned quota-aligned solution leadership and pipeline governance across enterprise pursuits and client portfolio expansion motions.
• Led technical discovery and solution mapping for enterprise financial-services pursuits

InsurTech Cloud Solutions — Chief Technology Officer
New York, NY | Apr 2014 – Mar 2017
Built safety operating-model framing around AWS shared responsibility and insurer-owned controls.
• Implemented SOC 2-aligned AWS controls for regulated insurers adopting analytics and ML.
• Re-architected insurer underwriting and operational systems for high availability and real-time operations.

Ernst & Young — Principal
New York, NY | Oct 2009 – Mar 2014
Led quantitative derivatives, variable-annuity hedging, and insurance-capital work using exotic pricing, liability Greeks, higher-order stress testing, and hedge design.
• Led CCAR-era capital, liquidity, stress testing, and model-validation work by structuring traceable scenarios, challenger variants, model-risk remediation, and governance evidence for regulated financial institutions.
• Architected ERM operating models and BCBS 239-aligned risk-data aggregation by defining three-lines-of-defense accountability, metadata standards, and auditable risk metrics.

Early Career Roles — Actuarial Consultant and Quantitative Roles
Philadelphia, PA | Oct 2002 – Sep 2009
• Actuarial & Quantitative Foundation: As a Fellow of the Society of Actuaries (FSA), priced exotic derivatives and structured multi-Greek hedging strategies, built stochastic capital models, and supported HPC-based valuation frameworks for scenario testing and capital adequacy — the quantitative rigor and risk discipline that now underpin my work in AI platform architecture and runtime governance.

EDUCATION
Master of Science in Biostatistics, Columbia University (Graduated with Distinction)
Bachelor of Arts in Biology, Brown University (Graduated Cum Laude)

CERTIFICATIONS & CREDENTIALS
Certified Machine Learning Engineer – Associate, AWS, 2025
Databricks Lakehouse Fundamentals Accreditation, 2023
Certified Solutions Architect – Professional, AWS, 2023
Fellow of the Society of Actuaries, 2010
